headline: DMV Fantasy: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: DMV Fantasy is projected #14 of 16 with a 533.40 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Breece Hall, George Kittle, and Jaxson Dart. The immediate priority is improving the WR slot without weakening that core.
